title: Arabian Kebab Delight
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab dish inspired by the streets of Arabia, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together saudi arabian ingredients and 2 tbsp olive oil.
2. Add the fish pieces to the marinade and mix well.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Thread the marinated fish onto kebab skewers.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Garnish with crispy ingredients and serve hot.
7. Serve with your favorite sides, such as rice or salad.
